notes.title: Patch 1.07
notes.notes:
After Steam updated the SDK, the achievement script was rendered useless and would cause the game to crash upon unlocking achievements such as finding your dog or friends.

This patch updates Cyanic's Script to a more updated version which fixes the issue.

notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.notes:
- The doorways in the school no longer teleports you to Dungeon 3.

- You no longer immediately leave when entering the door the Teacher unlocks for you after retrieving his items.

- The shopping center at Rogue Port now sells items and the merchant has dialogue.

- The Mayor's speech now changes after saving all your friends.

- Bosses no longer respawn.

- The treasure chest for the dantai clone number 7 now appears after being defeated.

- The final boss dungeon at tile A3/A2 no longer closes due to an incorrect map graphic.

- The Skyscraper City Residence with Sisters no longer has incorrect teleporters and no longer closes the game.
